rule: One unit per device role, the fewest parts that let every medium and every basic user journey run on camera. Everything else is stage two. Part ids refer to hardware/shopping/parts/<id>.json; prices and links come from mvp-checkout.json (verified 2026-09-14).

devices.name: xKoin-Node
devices.journey: Backhaul in, meters every WAN byte, injects the bulk plane onto the mains, carries the narrowband receipt plane and the LoRa survival plane. Demos D1, D2, D4, D5, D6.

parts.note: TL-WPA4220KIT: the TL-PA4010 half sits at the Node as injector, the TL-WPA4220 half is the Node-Satellite's Wi-Fi extractor

owned: USB 5 V phone charger for the board and the KQ-130F
the home router or a phone hotspot as backhaul

devices.name: xKoin-Node-Satellite
devices.journey: Wall-socket relay on the same mains segment: pulls the bulk plane off the mains, regenerates Wi-Fi for the phone, enforces admission through the captive portal. Demos D1, D4, D5.
owned: the TL-WPA4220 half of the Node's kit

devices.name: xKoin-Satellite
devices.journey: Off-grid LoRa remote on solar and a cell, deep sleep, class C service through 60 dB of simulated distance. Demos D2, D6.

parts.note: cells do not ship; INR 2600 mAh listing, or esp-ke at 280

devices.name: xKoin-Client OTG dongle
devices.journey: A phone with no Wi-Fi in reach plugs the dongle in and chats, checks balance and redeems a voucher over LoRa. The Wi-Fi client journey needs no parts: it is the phone on the Node-Satellite's Wi-Fi.

devices.name: LoRa ecosystem farm node
devices.journey: A third-party style sensor node rides the free LAN plane: soil moisture and temperature land on the Node dashboard with zero XKN spent. Demo D6.

parts.note: Martin 2026-09-14: second E22-900M22S instead of the Ra-01SH, which ships mid November

devices.name: Bench
devices.journey: What every demo shares: the simulated distance for D2, one mains strip for D1, the console lead and the breadboard.

parts.note: 4 way UK strip; price is a budget figure, not a checked listing

owned: plug-in RCD if the KQ-130F goes on mains
